messages:
elaine: Quick postmortem follow-up from the Vela customer isolation event — I extracted the root causes: flapping VPC peering sessions triggered the isolation fallback path, and the on‑prem NAT device ran out of ephemeral ports which amplified reconnect storms. I sketched a short action list, need owners + realistic timelines. Doc w/ packet captures + timeline: https://intra.redwood/pm/vela-isolation

sandeep: I'll take the VPC peer side — prioritize exponential backoff + circuit breaker and export peer session metrics. Target: prototype PR by Mon 03/29. I'll add unit + integration tests.

jon: I can own the on‑prem remediation runbook and preflight checks (ports, TCP conn thresholds, NAT table sizes). Asking for EOD Tue 03/31 for initial runbook. Will need help from customer infra when we request tcpdump.

mira: Ops: can we get an alert for repeated BGP session flaps or sustained TCP reset rate? Want threshold to avoid noisy starts. infra-bot: created alert ticket ALERT-8712 and assigned to eng-infra.

infra-bot: ALERT-8712 created: "VPC peer: BGP flaps >3 in 10m or TCP resets >500/min" — https://tracker.redwood/ALERT-8712

jon: Adding a simple connectivity check to the runbook, e.g. run on customer host:
```
# count established connections
netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
# check ephemeral port usage
ss -s | grep ephemeral
```
Will include exact commands + expected ranges.

sandeep: For the retry logic, thinking of a max backoff cap + token bucket to prevent bursts. Also will expose per-tenant metrics for peer reauth rate. Action A1 listed below.

liz: I'll handle customer comms and coordinate a joint test window. Please ping me once you have the runbook + test checklist. I'll schedule the meeting for the week of 04/01 if that works.

elaine: Consolidated action items (short):
- A1: VPC peer retry + circuit breaker — owner: sandeep — due: 2026-03-29
- A2: On‑prem NAT preflight runbook + tcpdump checklist — owner: jon — due: 2026-03-31
- A3: Ops alerts for BGP/TCP resets — owner: eng-infra (ops) — infra-bot ticket ALERT-8712
- A4: Customer test coordination + comms — owner: liz — due: 2026-04-02
- A5: Short-term mitigation: enable per-tenant isolation cooldown (throttle reconnects at edge) — owner: mira — due: 2026-03-26

sandeep: quick note — A1 will include a config flag so Dedicated customers can opt into aggressive retry suppression. Will add config + docs.

jon: I'll include a troubleshooting checklist with exact commands and expected outputs. Also adding a step to verify NAT table size and ephemeral exhaustion patterns.

mira: I'll add a Grafana dashboard panel for "peer flap rate" and a dashboard snippet to the runbook. ETA Fri 03/27.

liz: :thumbsup: once owners post PR links, I'll include them in the customer postmortem email and follow-up timeline.

elaine: locking owners and dates for now. We'll review progress in the incident follow-up sync on Thu 03/25 10:00 PT. Please drop PR links or ticket IDs here as you create them. Thanks everyone. :pray:
